author: paper-design
name: halftone-cmyk
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Halftone CMYK style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 5-color palette (#FBFAF5, #00B4FF, #FC519F, #FFD800, #231F20). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
